scope: Read-only independent verification of the compact partial run; no policy, environment, rendering or heavy Torch execution. A passed audit does not mean the planned experiment completed.

cases.limitation: No executed_steps, call record, trajectory, result or receipt exists; cannot count this case as completed or as a task failure.

termination.stale_explanation: MemoryGuard writes the stop sidecar then calls os._exit(72), bypassing run finally, final run-record update and active.lock unlink. The stale running_episodes label/lock does not imply the process is active. The memory_stop sidecar is authoritative for the observed stop; original files were not rewritten or deleted.
termination.peak_limitation: The preserved stop RSS is the sampled threshold-crossing value, not a complete run peak. Normal guard.finish samples were not persisted after os._exit.

reporting_constraints: Keep the denominator at four planned cases; report three completed successes and one infrastructure interruption before actions.
Do not present three of three as completion of the full matrix, classify the fourth as an unsuccessful robot task, or omit it.
No held-out generalization, matched SmolVLA comparison, original BF16 quality equivalence, real-time control or physical robot claim.
The arena parity proves exact saved-action replay for the tested cases, not demonstrated RSS saving.
Future fresh-process experiments require a separate frozen output and must not overwrite or pool away this failed attempt.
checkpoint_scope: Pinned input snapshot and loading audits verified; this lightweight audit does not reread the full checkpoint.
